title: Jagged Spear

sources.title: Torturous Edges
markers: | summary = '''Torturous Edges''' is a passive feature that [[Tortured (condition)|tortures]] its targets.

sources.title: Rush Attack
markers: | description = Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them {{SmCond|Off Balance}}.

summary: A spear with Torturous Edges. A target that fails its hidden Charisma save has disadvantage on Constitution saves for 2 turns.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength modifier. Simple, versatile, thrown, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Torturous Edges: On a hit, target makes a hidden DC 10 Charisma save. On failure it is Tortured for 2 turns, giving disadvantage on Constitution saves.
fields.Rush Attack: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Rush up to 30 ft and attack the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 Piercing plus the attack ability modifier. Strength save against weapon-action DC or Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 330 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
